description: Immutable directory structure baseline for NOA unified architecture

sys/core.description: Trusted microkernel - identity, policy, scheduler, registry, enforcement

gateway/mcp.description: Tool bus - routes tool calls to MCP servers with authz and routing

providers.description: Model providers with local, remote, shared resources, and pool

sandbox.description: Execution containment - per-task workspaces, limits, snapshots

data/cas.description: Content-addressed storage - immutable artifacts with refs and GC

invariants: Agents never touch the world except through Gateway MCP
Connectors that agents can call live at gateway/mcp/connectors/
Execution happens in sandbox; durable outputs go to CAS
Multiple task apps unify through Task Kernel
Configs follow Layer1 base + Layer2 semantic + Layer3 enforcement
